candidates.description: This vector represents words related to taking possession, occupying, or halting, often centered around the root concepts of seizing and ceasing.
This vector represents verbs and actions related to making commitments, making offers, or imposing demands.
This vector represents temporal sequencing and chronological ordering relations.
This vector represents major geographical regions, oceans, and continents of the world.
This feature activates on terms related to conflict, hostility, and geopolitical or interpersonal tension.
This feature vector represents armed conflict and military combat.
This feature vector represents concepts related to military combat, aggression, and tactical defense or offense.
This vector represents the concept of military incursions, invasions, and resistance against them.
These tokens represent the concept of change, modification, and progression in state or quantity.
This vector represents the concept of providing help, support, or assistance, along with its opposite (resistance).
